program='''def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()

    for r in range(height):
        for c in range(width):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if (r, c) in seen:
                continue

            component = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            for y, x in component:
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= yy < height and 0 <= xx < width
                            and (yy, xx) not in seen
                            and grid[yy][xx] == color):
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        component.append((yy, xx))

            y0 = min(y for y, _ in component)
            y1 = max(y for y, _ in component)
            x0 = min(x for _, x in component)
            x1 = max(x for _, x in component)
            if y1 - y0 < 2 or x1 - x0 < 2:
                continue

            perimeter = 2 * (y1 - y0 + 1) + 2 * (x1 - x0 - 1)
            if len(component) != perimeter:
                continue
            if not all(grid[y0][x] == color and grid[y1][x] == color
                       for x in range(x0, x1 + 1)):
                continue
            if not all(grid[y][x0] == color and grid[y][x1] == color
                       for y in range(y0, y1 + 1)):
                continue

            fill = 7 if (y1 - y0 - 1) % 2 else 2
            for y in range(y0 + 1, y1):
                for x in range(x0 + 1, x1):
                    result[y][x] = fill

    return result
'''
program_dir=p.parent
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)
